notes: FIXED 2026-05-13 — (a) join_key was MIMES_ID per DEC-026/D-10 but the polygon-ID audit showed the CSV's Polygon_ID values (0..173) match the polygon shape's `id` field at 98%, not MIMES_ID. (b) csv_key field added in the same fix because the converter previously used join_key for BOTH the CSV column AND the polygon field — but real CSVs always use `Polygon_ID` while polygon shapes use `id`/`MIMES_ID`. New csv_key=Polygon_ID + join_key=id is now correct for both sides. (c) Notes timestamp bumped 2026-05-13T02:30 UTC to force a new content hash + new version + new CDN etag — the prior fix produced different OUTPUT bytes but the publish hash key from INPUT bytes was unchanged so the CDN kept serving the old 0-feature response under the same etag.
